summary: All 14 findings applied, none declined. Warnings across the 13 skills in scope fall from 59 to 8, errors stay at 0 for every skill. The 12 restatement findings (R60A-003..R60A-014) were fixed two ways and never by rewording a claim: a row that repeats a fact an owner skill already states under the identical quote got a one-clause pointer naming that owner (build-adapter-pair, build-ceremony, build-definition-of-done, build-evidence-record, agentic-stack, cap-errors or cap-document-validation, whichever the validator named), and a row that restated a fact and then extended it got the clause after the marker marked as this skill's own proposed consequence. Physically splitting each restate-and-extend row into a second row was considered and not taken: five of the twelve skills already sit at the 10-instruction or 10-invariant ceiling the validator checks, so a split would have traded one warning class for another, and the in-row proposed marker is the form cap-tool-access, cap-tool-access-implement, cap-policy, cap-model-access, cap-work-intake and cap-errors itself already use at zero warnings, so the batch now reads the same way as the rest of the repository. The two definition-of-done findings were both closed by rewriting the text to the exact command and then re-running tools/measure.py against that same command, so text and evidence agree by construction rather than by assertion. R60A-001's root cause is recorded in the breakage text itself: harness/errors/test.sh section 4 applies the adapters/second.py patch internally to a copy, so a hand edit to the shipped file makes its own string replace miss and the harness reports a desynchronisation instead of the failure under test; the new breakage opens the closed registry gate in interface.py instead, which the conformance run covers on both bindings and which section 4 tolerates. Both re-measured rows keep status measured. No definition_of_done was touched outside the two findings, no adapters or composes_with row was edited, and no quote or citation was changed anywhere.
